scripts.verify:vercel-output: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.vercel/output/config.json','utf8'));const root=config.routes.some((route)=>route.src==='^/$'&&route.dest==='_render');const fn=fs.existsSync('.vercel/output/functions/_render.func/.vc-config.json');if(!root||!fn)throw new Error('Vercel render route is missing');console.log('Vercel root route and render function verified.');"
